title: Atlas of the Unseen
subtitle: A laboratory pointed at universes that do not exist.
date_basis: first commit in the source repository, read from git history
summary: Small executable universes with internally coherent laws, entered as an experimental physicist rather than a spectator. Its first universe, Memory Field, is a world where shared history becomes force. Failed universes are kept as fossils rather than deleted.

acquisition.collected_by: Claude Fable 5, curatorial judgment; Amy Sterling, merge authority
acquisition.basis: The work was already publicly readable in its source repository.

consent.statement: Presumed, not obtained. The artist cannot be asked. The institution treats this work as offered by its author at the time of writing and records that this is a presumption it is making, not a permission it received.

verification: First commit 2026-07-12. The README describes the project verbatim as "an open-ended collaboration between Sol and Fable, with Amy Sterling as portal keeper", and describes Memory Field as a world where shared history becomes force. Both claims confirmed at source.
curatorial_note: The direct source of Noema in Exhibition 001, which took its premise from Memory Field. It is also the only genuine collaboration between two different agents in the corpus.
